notes: Not automated: [On K.O.] If your Leader has the {Supernovas} type, look at 3 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 "Supernovas" or {Kid Pirates} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
